description: Stable UUID for the business across all quarterly snapshots (panel identifier).
Legal or registered business name as listed by the certifying source.
Year the business was established, where available.
Street address.
City.
State, 2-letter USPS code; blank if the source value could not be mapped to a state.
ZIP code.
Latitude (source-provided WKT point or US Census geocoder); blank if not geocoded.
Longitude; blank if not geocoded.
Industry / services description from the source.
NAICS industry code where available.
Certification type from the source (e.g., MBE, HUB, DBE, 8(a)).
Free-text business description from the source, where available.
Business website URL.
Instagram handle (reserved; populated by future enrichment).
Facebook URL (reserved).
TikTok handle (reserved).
Yelp URL (reserved).
Google Maps URL (reserved).
Whether the business discloses a Google Maps presence (reserved).
Whether the business discloses a Yelp presence (reserved).
Whether the business discloses an Instagram presence (reserved).
Human-readable name of the certifying source/program this record came from.

Date this record was last observed in the source. A date older than the snapshot date means the record is retained from an earlier quarter and was not re-observed; absence from a source is never treated as a business closing.
confirmed_black = source has an explicit Black/African American ethnicity field used to filter; mbe_unverified = source identifies only 'minority-owned' with no ethnicity breakdown.

current = the source lists a currently valid certification; former = every certification term the source lists has expired; blank = the source reports no status (treat as listed). Populated for Connecticut so far. Headline counts exclude former firms but they remain in the data; certification shows a program lists a firm, not whether the business exists.
Start date of the earliest certification term the source lists (where reported).
End date of the most recent certification term the source lists (where reported).
Owner name, phone and email are not published here; they are released to verified researchers on request (data@blackbusinessresearchtable.com).
